en.bilal-muhammad: Muhammad b. Musa b. al-Mutawakkil (ra) narrated to us. He said: `Ali b. al-Husayn al-Sa`d Abadi narrated to us from Ahmad b. Muhammad b. Khalid from `Uthman b. `Isa from Khalid b. Najih al-Jawaz from Wahb b. `Abd Rabbih. He said: I heard Aba `Abdillah al-Sadiq (as) say:
Whoever says “Allah knows” regarding something that he does not know, the Throne shakes out of the greatness of Allah.
